{{Quote|We've had a lucky break. An informant of ours, inside CorSec, has managed to plant a tracking device on the CorSec officer who is leading the investigation on the Lady Hutt. I think its time to bring this problem to an end. If this officer were to 'disappear' our problems should evaporate like so much spiced tea.|Lasha Bindari|<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Spice tea''', or '''spiced tea''', was a type of [[Tea/Legends|tea]].<ref name="SWG" /> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a trader taught the bartender of the [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]] cantina how to make delicious spiced tea.<ref name="SWG:TtC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Trader|Teaching the Craft|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> A trader also prepared glasses of tea for the [[Muna Skish]] at the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Spaceport Cantina]].<ref name="SWG:C">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Trader|Crafting|Tatooine}}</ref>
